captions.caption: A serene beach scene unfolds under a clear blue sky, with two people enjoying the tranquil turquoise waters. One person sits on the sand near a blue and white umbrella, while another stands at the shoreline, holding up a phone to capture the view. The camera pans slightly, focusing on the standing person as a small airplane flies steadily across the distant horizon, adding a sense of peaceful motion to the idyllic coastal setting.

On a bright, sunny day at a tropical beach with turquoise waters, a large passenger airplane descends for landing, drawing the attention of beachgoers who stand and point at the sky, capturing the moment with their phones as the aircraft flies low over the ocean.

A KLM Boeing 747 makes a low, scenic approach over a turquoise beach, drawing the attention of onlookers who capture the moment on their phones, before landing on the runway with a backdrop of hills and clouds.

A KLM Boeing 747 executes a dramatic low-altitude approach over a turquoise beach, drawing the attention of onlookers before landing on the runway, visible through a chain-link fence, and rolling to a stop with smoke rising from its tires.
